topic: FDIC insurance covers far more than $250k at one bank if the money sits in different ownership categories
title: The FDIC's $250k Insurance Limit Is Not What You Think
description:
Everyone thinks FDIC insurance tops out at $250,000 per bank. That's not the whole story. The fine print allows for millions to be insured at a single institution, if you know the rules.
